weapon_class.resonantcombat.sword.desc: Balanced blade combat with flexible offense, counters, and reliable combo flow. All-rounder.
weapon_class.resonantcombat.broadblade.d: Heavy weapons with slow attacks, wide hitboxes, high posture damage, and strong stagger potential. Heavy melee.
weapon_class.resonantcombat.spear.desc: Long-reaching thrusts, spacing control, directional attacks, and tactical mobility. Reach and control.
weapon_class.resonantcombat.bow.desc: Ranged precision, mobility, target marking, aerial volleys, and controlled burst damage. Ranged combat.
weapon_class.resonantcombat.saber.desc: Fast technical melee focused on timing, counters, rapid cuts, and precision. High-skill duelist.
